notes: I changed the insertion index: it's computed as `len(original)//2` minus the number of leading whitespace characters (clamped to the stripped length), not `len(stripped)//2`. This explains why `"  hello"` → `"hiello"` (index 1) while `"level"` → `"leivel"` (index 2), and is consistent with all E1/E2 cases.
